desc: An untextured clay-style orbit, for judging form before spending a mesh run. Clay mode is documented but unrendered here.
source_prompt: a single stylised animal figurine standing on a round flat base, thick limbs tucked close to the body, rounded solid forms, the whole figurine inside the frame with margin on all sides, three-quarter view, flat mid-grey seamless background, even frontal light, no cast shadow, no other objects
output: 90-frame 1024x1024 orbit MP4 (3.6 s at 25 fps) plus a .spz Gaussian splat file. No GLB mesh.
usable_for: judging silhouette and form without colour hiding defects, deciding whether a subject is worth a 19.5 s Hunyuan3D run
not_usable_for: any mesh or game use - no faces, no UVs. Clay shading here is a render style on a splat, not a real untextured mesh.
note: PARTIAL, and here is exactly which part: render_style is set to clay, and clay is listed as an accepted value of RenderSplat in workflow 25's notes alongside depth and normal - but only the default color has ever actually been rendered on this box. Treat clay as untested. If it errors, the value is wrong or the node build differs; fall back to color, which is verified. Everything else in this preset is identical to the two verified turntables.
